title: TLAMA sanitized Devnet evidence

signatures.description: All required scenario keys, each with canonical base58 signature, positive slot, confirmationStatus finalized, and outcome successful or rejected. Rejection scenarios must use outcome rejected.

accountSnapshots.description: All six manifest ID keys, each with address, public owner, nonnegative lamports, lowercase dataSha256, positive slot, and confirmationStatus finalized.

scenarios.description: All required scenario keys with value true.

description: The Python verifier is normative: it rejects extra keys and secret-like field names, binds source/artifact hashes and IDs to the supplied frozen manifest, and requires finalized public evidence.
